note: Cached canonical HTML contract essentials from learn_post_authoring. Reuse across daily runs.

theme_defaults.post_theme_source: publication_default (no per-post theme override is used; the dark look comes entirely from per-section inline data-background-color=#222222 and data-color=#FFFFFF). Do NOT call save_post_theme — established posts rely on inline section colors.

established_template.description: AI Current dark theme. Every block is wrapped in a node-section div with data-background-color #222222 and padding 20 (18 for section-header image blocks); text sections add data-color #FFFFFF. Structure: (1) cover image 16:9 imageBlock, 30px rounded corners; (2) intro paragraph 'Good morning. It's , ...'; (3) grouped story sections, each = an h2 heading section + a reusable abstract header-image section + one paragraph section whose stories open with lead-in. and end with a (Source) citation; (4) sign-off paragraph; (5) full-width 'Share AI Current' button linking {{rp_referral_hub_url}}. Group headings used: 'Funding & Markets', 'Models & Products', 'Infrastructure & Policy'.

ad_nodes.learning_2026-11-21: Place ad-network ads from list_ad_offers by their numeric offer id (claimed automatically on save). Do NOT set data-advertisement-kind='primary' on more than one ad — the server rejects with 'No primary ad slot is available'; omit data-advertisement-kind and let the server pick the creative/slot. Accepted opportunities from list_ad_opportunities may already be placed in another draft ('already placed in another post' error) — prefer unclaimed available_offers.
